resources.title: Life Stack Righteous Fire Chieftain Guide + Uber Showcase | PoE 1 3.28 Mirage
resources.creator: Pohx
resources.noteEs: Pohx, anchor de bossing y RF en PoE 1, presenta su build Life Stack Righteous Fire Chieftain con showcase de Uber bosses en 3.28 Mirage. Cubre setup completo, gear progression para uber-tier, y videos de cada uber kill. Anchor obligatorio del cluster boss-guides.
resources.noteEn: Pohx, the bossing and RF anchor in PoE 1, presents his Life Stack Righteous Fire Chieftain build with Uber boss showcase in 3.28 Mirage. Covers full setup, gear progression for uber-tier, and kill videos for each uber. Mandatory anchor of the boss-guides cluster.

resources.title: Mini-Guide on the NEW ENDGAME BOSSES & My Thoughts On Them
resources.creator: Zizaran
resources.noteEs: Zizaran (codex de PoE 1) presenta los nuevos endgame bosses introducidos por GGG en 3.25 — mecánicas, cómo desbloquearlos, threat tier por boss, y opinión editorial sobre si justifican el grind para alcanzarlos. Aunque es de mediados de 2025, los bosses siguen vigentes en 3.28.
resources.noteEn: Zizaran (PoE 1 codex) presents the new endgame bosses introduced by GGG in 3.25 — mechanics, how to unlock them, threat tier per boss, and editorial opinion on whether they justify the grind to reach them. Although from mid-2025, the bosses remain active in 3.28.

resources.title: PoE 3.28 — How Profitable is THE FEARED?
resources.creator: Lolcohol
resources.noteEs: The Feared es uno de los pinnacle bosses más rentables de PoE 1, pero el setup es caro y la dificultad es alta. Lolcohol calcula matemáticamente si vale la pena: cost del invitation, drop tables, expected divine/hour, y comparison contra alternativas como Uber Sirus o Maven. Material para players considerando boss-rushing como income main.
resources.noteEn: The Feared is one of PoE 1's most profitable pinnacle bosses, but the setup is expensive and difficulty is high. Lolcohol calculates mathematically whether it's worth it: invitation cost, drop tables, expected divine/hour, and comparison against alternatives like Uber Sirus or Maven. Material for players considering boss-rushing as main income.

resources.title: Nightmare Boss Rushing for 25D/Hour: Easy Fragment Farm in 3.28 Mirage
resources.creator: Vascor
resources.noteEs: Vascor presenta una estrategia menos demandante de gear para sostener bossing income en 3.28 Mirage: rushear Nightmare Maps por sus fragmentos. 25 divines/hora con setup accesible. Boss-as-income más accesible que el setup uber, complementario al deep-dive de Lolcohol.
resources.noteEn: Vascor presents a less gear-demanding strategy to sustain bossing income in 3.28 Mirage: rushing Nightmare Maps for their fragments. 25 divines/hour with accessible setup. Boss-as-income more accessible than uber setup, complementary to Lolcohol's deep-dive.

resources.title: SIRUS — Boss Fight Guide — Path of Exile Beginner Friendly Guide
resources.creator: HeavyHeals
resources.noteEs: Sirus, Awakener of the Worlds es uno de los pinnacle bosses fundamentales de PoE 1 — todo player serio lo enfrenta múltiples veces. HeavyHeals da una guía completa para principiantes en 19 minutos: cada fase, cada mecánica, errores típicos. La pelea no cambió desde 3.13 lo cual hace al video evergreen aunque sea de 2024.
resources.noteEn: Sirus, Awakener of the Worlds is one of PoE 1's fundamental pinnacle bosses — every serious player faces him multiple times. HeavyHeals gives a complete beginner guide in 19 minutes: every phase, every mechanic, typical mistakes. The fight hasn't changed since 3.13, which makes the video evergreen despite being from 2024.
